## Summary
- Add an opt-in `openai_compat` backend for `local-ai-reviewer` so Step 7 can call DeepSeek (or Qwen/GLM) when Codex quota is exhausted.
- Keep Codex as the shared default. Same JSON review contract; the HTTP preset inlines `REVIEW.md`, the context bundle, and a bounded diff.
- Closes #1711.


## Planted-violation proof

This PR does not add a lint rule, CI job, or repo-wide file scanner. Fail-closed setup checks in `local-openai-review-command.sh` are proven by unit tests that plant the violation, assert failure, then restore the env:

| Check | Planted violation | Fail assertion | Location |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| missing BASE_BRANCH | unset BASE_BRANCH | `openai_missing_base_branch_exits` | command L101; test L271 |
| git diff failure | MOCK_GIT_FAIL=1 | `openai_git_diff_failure_exits` | command L107; test L250 |
| missing credentials | unset API keys | `openai_missing_credentials` | command L66; test L184 |
| missing REVIEW.md | rename REVIEW.md | `openai_missing_review_md` | command L74; test L223 |
| missing model / base URL / context | unset env | matching `openai_missing_*` tests | command L58 / L62 / L70 |
| HTTP 401 / 500 | MOCK_HTTP_CODE | `openai_http_401_exits`, `openai_http_500_exits` | command L179 / L183 |

E2E fixture contract is not applicable (template placeholder E2E job).

## Test plan
- [x] `bash scripts/development-workflow/tests/test-local-openai-review-command.sh` (33 passed)
- [x] `python3 scripts/lint/workflow-shell-guard-lint.py --base-ref origin/develop` (exit 0)
- [x] `python3 scripts/lint/workflow-shell-snippet-lint.py --base-ref origin/develop` (`examined=6 files, 2 fences, 512 changed-lines; findings=0`)
- [x] Live DeepSeek review against this draft PR via `local-openai-reviewer.sh` (fixer cycles applied)
- [x] Codex default remains `codex` when `LOCAL_AI_REVIEWER_BACKEND` is unset

<!-- CURSOR_SUMMARY -->
---

> [!NOTE]
> **Medium Risk**
> Changes the default resolution path for a core draft review gate and sends PR/diff content to external HTTP APIs when enabled, though behavior is opt-in and Codex remains the default.
> 
> **Overview**
> Adds an **opt-in OpenAI-compatible HTTP backend** for Step 7’s `local-ai-reviewer`, so draft reviews can run against DeepSeek (or any `/chat/completions` API) when Codex isn’t available. **Codex stays the default** when `LOCAL_AI_REVIEWER_BACKEND` is unset.
> 
> `local-ai-reviewer.sh` now picks the bundled preset from **`LOCAL_AI_REVIEWER_BACKEND`** (`codex` vs `openai_compat`), rejects unknown values with **`RESULT=escalate`**, and documents new env vars (model, base URL, API key / key command).
> 
> The new **`local-openai-review-command.sh`** preset POSTs to the remote API with **`REVIEW.md`**, the context bundle, and a **bounded unified diff** inlined in the prompt (remote models can’t read the repo). **`local-openai-reviewer.sh`** is a thin wrapper; **`.ai-dev-workflow.local.env.example`** and gitignore support local secrets. Docs, workflow YAML comments, changelog, and **`test-local-openai-review-command.sh`** cover setup and behavior.
>
